code:
with payments as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_jaffle_shop__payments') }}
),
aggregated as (
    select
        order_id,
        sum(amount) as amount,
        max_by(payment_method, amount) as payment_method
    from payments
    group by order_id
)
select * from aggregated
caption: One row per order_id — sum(amount) correctly combines a split payment into the real total.
The join is now one-to-one again, matching what it was always written to assume.

code:
dbt run --full-refresh --select int_payments__aggregated fct_orders
dbt test --select fct_orders
caption: --full-refresh is required: the old incremental data already has the fanout's duplicates baked in.
